mapper.select: SELECT * FROM seckill_product WHERE id = #{id} AND is_del = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO seckill_product (id, product_id, with_hold_quantity, remain_quantity, price, start_time, end_time, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, is_del) VALUES (#{id}, #{productId}, #{withHoldQuantity}, #{remainQuantity}, #{price}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{createUserId}, #{createUserName}, now(3), 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE seckill_product SET with_hold_quantity = with_hold_quantity - 1, update_time = now(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND with_hold_quantity > 0
UPDATE seckill_product SET with_hold_quantity = with_hold_quantity + 1, update_time = now(3) WHERE id = #{id}
